s1.label: ResumeDOG
s1.heading: Built for the work recruiters do before submission.
s1.body: ResumeDOG was created to reduce the manual document work that happens between receiving a candidate resume and sending a client-ready version to an employer. It helps recruitment agencies format, translate, anonymize, tailor, review, and export resumes more consistently.

s2.label: The Problem
s2.heading: Resume preparation is still too manual.
s2.body: Recruiters often receive resumes in different formats, languages, structures, and levels of quality. Before a candidate can be submitted, the resume may need to be cleaned, translated, anonymized, reformatted, and tailored to a specific role. That work is repetitive, time-consuming, and hard to standardize across a team.

s3.label: The Solution
s3.heading: One workflow for cleaner candidate submissions.
s3.body: ResumeDOG brings the resume preparation workflow into one place. Recruiters upload a resume, choose the required settings, review the AI-generated version, and export a client-ready file.

s4.label: Our Approach
s4.heading: AI-assisted, recruiter-controlled.
s4.body: ResumeDOG is designed to support recruiters, not replace them. The platform helps with formatting, translation, anonymization, and document preparation, while recruiters stay responsible for reviewing and approving the final resume.
